news.title: Top Reviewer at NeurIPS 2026
news.description: Recognized as a Top Reviewer for NeurIPS 2026 by the conference program chairs.

news.title: Best Presentation Award at ECCV 2026 Workshop
news.description: Received the Best Presentation Award at the 2nd Data Curation and Augmentation in Medical Imaging Workshop at ECCV 2026 for "Building Foreign Object Segmentation Datasets for Chest X-Rays with Synthetic-trained Proposals".

news.title: Selected as Young Marsilius Fellow
news.description: Selected as one of 13 Young Marsilius Fellows (sixth cohort) at Heidelberg University's Marsilius-Kolleg for interdisciplinary research and science communication. Fellowship period: October 2026 – September 2027.

news.title: Joined the ELLIS Society
news.description: Accepted as a member of the ELLIS Society (European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems), the European network of excellence in machine learning research.

news.title: Attending ICML 2026
news.description: We will present Marios Koulakis' "The Data Manifold Under the Microscope" at the main conference and at the Mechanistic Interpretability workshop.

news.title: CVPR Tutorial: Identifying Structure in Data
news.description: Successfully presented our tutorial on dimensionality reduction, clustering, and data exploration techniques at CVPR 2024.

news.title: Junior Research Group Leadership
news.description: Started leading the Computer Vision in Medicine research group at University Medicine Essen.

news.title: PhD Completed with Summa Cum Laude
news.description: Successfully defended PhD thesis on automatic generation of medical reports in low supervision scenarios.

news.title: KIT Doctoral Award
news.description: Received the prestigious KIT Doctoral Award for outstanding dissertation research.
